system.description: Closed Channeling 3.10 - Symbolic Ways. Spells to emplace and remove spells in Symbols on stone, analyze Symbols, and prime the caster's next spell.
Caster learns what spell is emplaced within one Symbol within 50'. The Symbol will not be triggered (unless specifically created to be triggered by an Analyze Symbol spell).

This spell 'primes' the next spell cast by the caster — that spell is treated as if it were instantaneous. The PP cost of this spell is equal to the highest level that the caster desires to be primed. In addition, when casting this spell, the caster must pray for one minute per PP spent in the spell. Any interruption of this process results in the failure of this spell. The effects of this spell end when the caster casts his next spell (even if the next spell is higher level than the number of PPs expended on this spell).
Caster can remove one Symbol I (an emplaced 1st level spell). The Symbol's RR is based on the level of the spell in the Symbol spell (target level) and the level of the Unsymbol spell (attack level).

Caster can emplace one 1st level spell on any 1 given non-mobile stone (weighing at least 2,000 pounds; only one Symbol may be placed on each continuous slab, and the stone may not be moved without dispelling the Symbol). Within one minute, the spell to be emplaced must also be cast (within 10'). A Symbol can be triggered by time period, specified movements, specified sounds, touch, reading, violent actions in the area, etc. (decided by caster); the triggering range is normally 10' or the range of the emplaced spell, whichever is larger. If the spell emplaced is an attack spell, the attack level is the spell's level (not the level of the caster); if elemental, OB is normally +0, or +50 if focused on a location. Normally, if the Symbol affects a being or thing, it can be triggered only once per day.
As Symbol I, except a 2nd level spell is emplaced.
As Unsymbol I, except a 2nd level spell is removed.
As Symbol I, except a 3rd level spell is emplaced.
As Analyze Symbol, except caster learns what spells are emplaced in Symbols within 50' radius.
As Symbol I, except a 5th level spell may be emplaced.
As Unsymbol I, except a 3rd level spell is removed.
As Symbol I, except a 6th level spell is emplaced.
As Symbol I, except a 7th level spell is emplaced.
As Unsymbol I, except a 5th level spell is removed.
As Symbol I, except an 8th level spell is emplaced.
As Unsymbol I, except a 10th level spell is removed.
As Symbol I, except a 9th level spell is emplaced.
As Symbol I, except a 10th level spell is emplaced.
See Section 15.0 (research).
As Symbol I, except a 20th level spell is emplaced.
As Unsymbol I, except caster can remove any spell of a level less than his own (e.g., a 50th level Cleric could remove a 49th level spell, but not a 50th level spell).
